about: The Schnitzer Law Firm is a personal injury firm with a single office in Las Vegas.

The firm states that the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

json_ld_descriptions:
While some lawyers are afraid of the courtroom, Jordan Schnitzer loves it. The Schnitzer Law Firm has obtained multiple verdicts in jury trials in excess of $2 million. Jordan has been recognized for his exceptional skills and accomplishments in the courtroom by being named one of the top 10 trial attorneys under 40 in Nevada by the National Trial Lawyers Association. Insurance companies are more likely to make a fair offer when they know a skilled attorney like Jordan Schnitzer is willing to go to court to fight for his clients.

When you have been injured through no fault of your own, we know that winning is the only option. For that reason, we are relentless in our pursuit of justice for our injured clients.

The insurance companies are bullies and their sole mission is to keep as much money as they can for their executives and shareholders. Jordan knows this all too well, he used to represent them. In fact, he was head of the Las Vegas office for one of the largest insurance companies in the country. The only way to defeat a bully like the insurance companies is to stand up to them and let them know you will not be pushed around and they will not take advantage of you. Jordan has been standing up to the insurance companies for his clients for years and The Schnitzer Law Firm is ready to fight for you.
